# Font test fixtures

These WOFF2 files are a small subset of Inter, Lora and Lato from Fontsource 5.3.0, licensed under the SIL Open Font License (licences included). They cover Latin variable and static normal/italic faces for offline PHP and browser tests.

They are test data only. The production build copies `cms/` and the compiled admin, and does not include this directory. Website users download their own families through the font manager.
